judgment.rationale: A hotkey-registration or state defect remains possible, but Window Hopper intentionally cycles eligible windows of the foreground application, not the general Alt+Tab set. A no-op with fewer than two eligible same-application windows must be ruled out before calling this an Alt+Tab conflict. The missing discriminator is the exact foreground app/window scenario, not the already-provided layout or OS build.
evidence: The edited report corrects the original keyboard assumption: default Alt+Ø and Alt+Shift+Ø do work with Norwegian QWERTY and initially worked after reinstall without restoring the old backup.
Restarting, toggling the module, multiple alternative shortcuts, reinstalling and deleting the old backup have already been tried. Do not request the same resets or keyboard layout again.
The supplied report contains AltWindowCycle startup logs and configured Alt+Shift+Left/Right at capture time, but no successful/failed hotkey-to-window enumeration trace.

Source inspected at main 9227a8497750: src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp: GetAppWindows groups windows using the foreground executable; Switcher::OnHotkey returns without showing an overlay when fewer than two are eligible. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp

Source inspected at main 9227a8497750: src/modules/AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp: Configured shortcut IDs route to next/previous cycle handlers with a modifier mask. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/modules/AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp

Downloaded the existing ZIP and inspected AltWindowCycle settings and October 21–22 module logs. Initialization is recorded, but those logs do not establish whether the failing hotkey reached OnHotkey. No covering PR references this issue.
Reporter now explicitly confirms shortcuts work on 0.102.3101 and the issue no longer reproduces. That is a reporter-confirmed resolution, not proof of which commit fixed it.

fix_assessment.rationale: Reporter confirms recovery on 0.102.3101; no competing correction is warranted without renewed reproduction.
